debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-p-i-e-d a n-o-t-e-p-a-d f-r-o-m the s-h-a-r-e-d d-r-i-v-e and l-e-f-t a t-e-m-p o-r-d-e-r f-i-l-e in the r-o-o-t d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-h-a-n-g-e l-o-g r-e-v-i-e-w.
2) the a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d a k-e-y-b-o-a-r-d h-o-o-k o-n the l-o-c-a-l t-e-r-m-i-n-a-l and l-e-f-t a s-h-a-d-o-w c-o-n-f-i-g p-r-o-f-i-l-e in the h-o-m-e f-o-l-d-e-r w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-e-v-i-c-e a-u-d-i-t c-h-e-c-k.
3) the a-c-t-o-r r-u-n a s-c-r-i-p-t t-o r-e-n-a-m-e o-l-d log e-n-t-r-i-e-s and l-e-f-t a t-r-a-n-s-f-o-r-m r-e-p-o-r-t in the b-u-i-l-d o-u-t-p-u-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-r-o-m a-g-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
4) the a-c-t-o-r a-c-c-e-s-s-e-d the t-e-s-t d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e v-i-a the d-e-v i-p and l-e-f-t a c-o-n-n-e-c-t-i-o-n t-i-c-k in the n-e-t-w-o-r-k c-a-p-t-u-r-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-c-c-e-s-s r-e-c-o-r-d r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) the a-c-t-o-r c-l-o-s-e-d the e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e s-e-s-s-i-o-n and l-e-f-t a l-o-g-o-u-t f-l-a-g in the a-u-d-i-t r-a-i-l w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-n-a-l s-t-a-t-e c-o-n-f-i-r-m a-t-i-o-n.
